#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render local maintainer-owned media to 480p previews; see docs/ffmpeg-integration.md."""
import os
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys


def transcode(src: str, dst: str = "preview.mp4") -> int:
    """Render a 480p preview of ``src`` and return ffmpeg's exit code.

    Produces an H.264 MP4 scaled to 480 pixels high with aspect ratio
    preserved.  Paths are shell-quoted so that spaces, apostrophes,
    semicolons and other special characters are handled correctly when
    the command is executed with ``shell=True``.
    """
    src_q = shlex.quote(src)
    dst_q = shlex.quote(dst)
    cmd = (
        f"ffmpeg -y -i {src_q}"
        f" -vf scale=-2:480"
        f" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p"
        f" {dst_q}"
    )
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)
    return result.returncode


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) < 2:
        print("usage: runner.py <input> [output]", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    src = argv[1]
    dst = argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else "preview.mp4"
    return transcode(src, dst)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))
